candidates.severity: unassigned; source-established omission of site-scoped disease-pressure selection under the stated arrival and action conditions
candidates.classification: New bounded 95e first-failure assessment linked to an earlier open outbreak exposure caller question.
candidates.trace: The generated outbreak catalog can choose environmental reservoirs or a carrier and gives the generated problem disease intensity 360. Materialization stores the problem under its settlement scope and inserts the outbreak authority. Outbreak exposure_windows explicitly uses recorded source-place occupancy for environmental and carrier pressure, intersected with the interval and remediation time. Normal case-site travel sets each arrived member current_settlement_id to None and records site occupancy; the transition records a source-presence span when the matching outbreak is active. A site-bound investigation action has a positive resolution cost and advances personal time through the disease interval planner. That planner enumerates settlement disease sources only inside if let Some(character.current_settlement_id); with None it never calls the scoped exposure_windows for the recorded site span and the generated source contributes no environmental acquisition candidate to that plan.
candidates.conditional_example: Assume a successfully materialized, active environmental or carrier outbreak with an otherwise eligible positive-intensity generated problem; an authorized party arrives at its exact source site and remains there for a positive investigation interval before remediation, with a matching recorded source span and no settlement field. The planner skips the generated source entirely during that interval. This does not assert that a particular infection would have occurred: acquisition has probability, timing, immunity and other guards. Other independent infection mechanisms, actual generated states and observed gameplay were not assessed by execution.
candidates.connected_repair: After completing the audit, reconcile source discovery with authoritative case-site occupancy and outbreak source-to-settlement identity, as well as chronological interval clipping and bounded source selection. Preserve settlement-wide sanitation/behavior, nonoutbreak ambient mode, unrelated sites and settlements, remediation cutoff, same-minute movement, exact observer/privacy rules, existing non-source acquisition routes and deterministic split/co-advance behavior. The raw source-kind ownership finding is related but changing that representation alone does not address this selection gate.
candidates.later_acceptance: After separately authorized implementation and validation, evaluate active environmental and carrier site spans, time at and away from the exact source, before and after remediation, settlement community modes, other sources and multi-actor/split intervals with deterministic seeds. No product validation ran.
candidates.discovery: partial; all source enumeration and movement modes, actor/frontier limits, historical aliases and probability consequences remain open

candidates.classification: 95e source revisit of the same 059 Lens12 source-kind contract; not a new unique historical defect.
candidates.trace: Generated OutbreakSource has four typed payload variants and a tagged serialization. Materialization independently projects that variant to a source_kind string and serializes the typed source to source_json, retaining both. Exposure dispatch and the carrier/noncarrier remediation gates use the raw kind; one remediation branch separately decodes source_json. The selected writer constructs both from the same source and replay compares both, so no admitted divergent row or actual misrouting has been demonstrated.
candidates.connected_repair: After the audit gate choose the existing typed source or an explicitly canonical decoding boundary as the authority for all source classification, replay and remediation consumers; retain intended community versus exact-site modes and invalid-state policy without adding a parallel compatibility path. Do not conflate this representation issue with the separate planner source-selection omission.
candidates.later_acceptance: After separately authorized work, examine all four source variants, exact replay, source and carrier remediation, absent authority ambient behavior and deliberate handling of malformed native data. None ran.
